title: NEED A GOOD TIME?
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: original printable square MOTD promotional sticker, flat finished artwork, not a mockup.
Primary request: punk / underground hardcore music scene meets 1920s Soviet constructivist propaganda poster design. Strong graphic composition, bold imperfect typography, limited screenprinted inks, xerox grit, cut-and-paste fanzine energy. This is promotion for the Android IRC app motd.
Composition: square edge-to-edge ink artwork, no perspective, no photographed surroundings, no outer margin. Main headline and central illustration occupy the upper 74% of the square. A clean ivory horizontal footer occupies the bottom 24% and carries a large lowercase "motd" wordmark on the LEFT, with a simple slash inside a speech bubble as a secondary small brand emblem. Footer right is RESERVED for a REAL QR code inserted afterward: leave the rectangle from 76% to 94% of image width and 76% to 94% of image height completely BLANK and ivory. Do not generate a QR code, fake QR pattern, placeholder outline, caption, or any other mark in that reserved rectangle. Keep all decoration, lettering and illustration out of this reserved area.
Materials: worn silkscreen ink, photocopied halftones and paper grain in the main design, crisp strong silhouettes and readable type.
Constraints: render specified copy verbatim. Brand spelled m-o-t-d in lowercase. Only specified slogan and "motd" text. No URLs, no watermarks, no artist signature, no claims about app privacy. No political leaders or real party emblems. One complete sticker design only.
Subject: a defiant hardcore singer shouting into a wired microphone, tightly cropped three-quarter profile with mic cable slicing across the composition. Angular red wedges radiate behind the face like a revolutionary poster; urgent gig-flyer collage.
Color palette: vermilion red, charcoal black, warm ivory.
Text (verbatim): "NEED A GOOD TIME?" as huge stacked, slightly slanted condensed type across the top, and "motd" in the footer.
